name: Artifact Validation at Every Ingress
description: Every API request, file import, extension manifest, federation envelope, and control-plane write must be validated against the registry.
purpose: No unchecked data enters the system.
acceptanceCriteria: API requests validated against OpenAPI/schema registry at ingress middleware
File imports validated against expected schema before processing
Extension manifests validated on installation and update
Federation envelopes validated before dispatch or acceptance
Control-plane writes validated against schema registry
Validation failure returns structured error with schema reference
Validation metrics tracked: total, passed, failed per ingress point
